turns.prompt_text: where can you play the piano in Ankeny Iowa
turns.response_html: While Ankeny does not have public pianos available for casual play, the Des Moines-based City Sounds Public Piano Project places painted pianos in the greater Des Moines area. Other options include taking lessons at music schools like School of Rock, Passion Studios, or Selah Music, or attending dueling piano events at venues like The District Venue.
